train.via: Baltimore Penn Station to Washington Union Station

trips.route_note: Take a direct MARC or Amtrak train from Baltimore Penn Station to Washington Union Station (about 40 minutes), then use the Metro or walk to the National Mall.
see: White House exterior from Lafayette Square
trips.tour_query: Washington DC day trip from Baltimore
quests: Smithsonian National Museum of Natural History
trips.why: The direct MARC or Amtrak train from Baltimore Penn Station to Washington Union Station is the fastest option and leaves you a short Metro or walk from the National Mall.
know: Many Smithsonian museums on the National Mall are free to enter.
Train fares vary widely, so compare prices before booking.

train.via: Baltimore Penn Station to 30th Street Station

bus.via: Baltimore Downtown Bus Station to Philadelphia Bus Station

trips.route_note: Take a direct Amtrak Northeast Regional train from Baltimore Penn Station to Philadelphia 30th Street Station (about 1 hour 45 minutes), then walk or take a short transit ride to Independence Hall.
trips.why: The direct Amtrak Northeast Regional train from Baltimore Penn Station to Philadelphia 30th Street Station is faster than the bus and needs no changes.
know: Visits to Independence Hall are by timed ticket, so book ahead.
Train fares vary widely, so compare prices before booking.

bus.via: GREENE ST & LOMBARD ST sb fs to Church Cir & School St

trips.route_note: Take a direct commuter bus from central Baltimore to downtown Annapolis (roughly 45 to 60 minutes), then walk to the historic district.
see: Historic Main Street shops and restaurants
trips.why: The commuter bus runs from central Baltimore into downtown Annapolis, where the historic district is easy to explore on foot.
know: The historic district is best explored on foot once you arrive downtown.
